description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for preparing and freeing environment structures used in the LibXDiff library, specifically for handling diff operations. It declares function prototypes and include guards, and contains licensing and author information.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Prepares the diff environment with given file structures and parameters.

methods.name: xdl_free_env
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the diff environment.
